Placemaker.Look.lookBigTrees.Tooltip: Large old trees standing alone in the open, as part of the look.
Placemaker.Look.lookFlowerbeds.Tooltip: How many flowerbeds, mostly along the paths.
Placemaker.Look.lookPlazaTrees.Tooltip: Trees on the square: in a grid, or in planted islands.
Placemaker.Look.lookRockyAreas.Tooltip: Whole rocky zones: big rocks gathered on rough, painted ground.
Placemaker.Look.lookTerrainShape.Tooltip: Reshapes the land: gentle mounds, hills, terraces, a bowl, or flattened. Permanent.
Placemaker.Look.lookGroundPatches.Toolti: Patches of meadow, mown grass, dirt, gravel or sand across the open ground.
Placemaker.Look.lookWater.Tooltip: A pond or a bigger lake dug into the land. Permanent.
Placemaker.Look.lookShore.Tooltip: How the edge looks where the place meets water (only when it does).
Placemaker.Look.lookKickabout.Tooltip: An open lawn with two small goals for a casual game.
Placemaker.Look.lookTerraceGarden.Toolti: Stepped garden terraces round a statue or fountain.
Placemaker.Look.lookLightTowers.Tooltip: Tall light masts over the grounds.
Placemaker.Look.lookDebris.Tooltip: Dumped junk and rubble heaps, mostly along the edges.
Placemaker.Look.lookJunkPiles.Tooltip: Heaps of scrap, tyres, drums or rubbish.
Placemaker.Look.lookSkips.Tooltip: A row of skips and containers.
Placemaker.Look.lookSpoilHeaps.Tooltip: Heaps of dug earth, gravel or sand.
Placemaker.Look.lookWorkLights.Tooltip: Mobile light towers and generators round the site.
Placemaker.Look.lookBreakArea.Tooltip: A spot for the workers: tables, a cabin and a shelter.
